Name: SteckNY Lawn and Pasture
Author: SteckNy
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Create a neatly kept lawn or a living pasture for your animals. Plant the seeds once, then let the turf grow without watering. Cutting and grazing leave short, living turf that can grow back.

Two seeds. Two ways to use your farm.

- Lawn Seed creates a lawn that stays short by default. Choose Short, Growing or Mature as its maximum height.
- Pasture Seed creates renewable grass that can reach maturity for animals to eat.

Both seeds are additional items. Existing ordinary grass and blue grass are not converted or replaced.


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
- Close the game.
- Download SteckNYLawnPasture-1.0.0.zip.
- Extract its SteckNYLawnPasture folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Launch the game through SMAPI.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

A living growth cycle

- Short turf — the planted, cut or grazed stage.
- Growing grass — appears after 2 nights by default, using shorter native seasonal blades without the pink/yellow flower variant.
- Mature pasture — appears after 4 nights total by default and can feed animals.

No watering is required. Growth timing can be changed in the settings.

Mow, graze and regrow
Use any vanilla scythe tier to return growing or mature grass to short turf. Cutting mature pasture uses the native hay harvest rules; growing and short turf do not yield hay. Normal silo and scythe rules apply. Repeated swings over the same freshly cut turf do not produce more hay.

Animals target mature turf. Grazing returns the entire tile to short turf and uses the game's normal feeding/fullness logic. Allow time for the pasture to regrow, and keep enough mature grass or hay available for your animals.

To clear a tile completely, use a pickaxe. No seed is refunded. Ordinary weapons and explosions do not uproot this mod's turf.

Keep your lawn contained, or let the pasture spread
Lawns stay within their planted area. Pasture spreading is optional and disabled by default. When enabled, each mature pasture tile has a configurable daily chance to establish one adjacent short-turf tile on valid bare farm ground. New turf must mature before it can spread.

Turf survives winter. Growth and spreading pause by default, with an option to allow winter growth. Animals retain their normal weather and season behavior.

Crafting and planting

- Both recipes unlock when you load a save.
- Craft 5 Lawn Seed or 5 Pasture Seed using 5 Fiber + 1 Mixed Seeds.
- Plant on bare, untilled, diggable outdoor farm ground.
- Existing paths, objects, crops/tilled soil, water and blocked/occupied tiles cannot be overwritten.

Six configurable settings
With Generic Mod Config Menu installed, all settings appear in game:

- Maximum lawn height — Short, Growing or Mature; default Short.
- Days to growing grass — 1–27 days; default 2.
- Days to mature pasture — 2–28 days total; default 4. Maturity stays at least one day after growing.
- Pasture spreading — on/off; default Off.
- Daily spread chance — 0–100%; default 15%. Applies only when spreading is enabled.
- Grow in winter — on/off; default Off.

GMCM is optional. Without it, lawn and pasture use default settings.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Requires SMAPI (https://smapi.io/). Built and checked against Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.
